_about: The Mistbound Path and the Hollow Sentinel.
sentinel_first: I need to reach the tower.
All who climb must surrender what they carry.
Everyone says that before they remember.
sentinel: You are still here. Turn back. Or answer. Or endure.
sentinel_choices: A question wearing armour. Listen, and you may hear the rest.
The figure's outline wavers, like a memory struggling to hold its shape. (Stand close and press F to listen.)
Passage is not given. It is understood, or it is endured.
If you will not understand, then endure. Three breaths of the mist. Walk through them, and the road is yours.
Then stand in the cold a while. It is good for thinking.
Then walk. When the mist breathes, do not be in its breath.
Light gathers on the ground before each pulse. Cross while the mist is still. Walk back south to stop.
sentinel_echo: For a moment the armour is empty. Behind the visor: a boy's face, frightened, trying very hard not to be.
[wave amp=10 freq=2]Come home before dark, love. Supper's on.[/wave]
sentinel_story: I guarded this road when the first bell was cast.
The bell rang. They forgot my name.
sentinel_riddle: Tell me, traveller. What remains of a person when their name is forgotten?

choice.text: The things they chose to do.

sentinel_riddle: Then I am nothing. And nothing cannot step aside.
There is no one left who remembers me. Is that all I was? Something other people carried?
Think again. Or walk through the mist, if you would rather be brave than wise.
Then walk. When the mist breathes, do not be in its breath.
Light gathers on the ground before each pulse. Cross while the mist is still. Walk back south to stop.
I chose to stand here. Every night. Even after they forgot why.
sentinel_endured: You walked through it. Most turn back at the first breath.
Endurance is a kind of answer. Not the only one.
sentinel_mercy: Breathe. The mist is patient, and so am I.
I will hold it back a little. Not for long. Go when it is still.
sentinel_farewell: And when you reach the bell...
Ask it whose voice it borrowed.
path_shrine: A small roadside shrine. The name carved on its base has been chiselled away, every letter.
Someone still leaves pebbles on the ledge. Fresh ones.
path_shrine_echo: A woman stands at the shrine with a lantern, calling down the road toward the tower.
[wave amp=10 freq=2]Come home, love! Supper's going cold, and the bell's about to...[/wave]
The name she calls is a gap in the air. Your ears slide right off it.
She's calling a son who never came home. Calling a name the bell took.
